verdict.line: You can lose exchanges to Sion's Q (Cryptic Gaze) stun and Enrage-fueled autos before level 6, but the matchup is genuinely even overall and tips to you once Sunfire Aegis and Thornmail are online, backed by a 53.3% head-to-head win rate over 105 games and a solo-kill edge.

brief.thesis: Sion has no mana bar, so his only real tell is his Q (Cryptic Gaze) cooldown (12/11/10/9/8s) — once it's down he has no stun to punish your E (Searing Charge) engage. His E (Enrage) spends his own health for bonus attack damage, so every extended trade he wins is also draining his HP bar, which is exactly why Ornn holds a solo-kill advantage in this matchup even though the overall lane is rated even.

theirWindow.when: his Q (Cryptic Gaze) is off cooldown
theirWindow.what: Stay outside 550 range or behind minions until he throws it away on a creep. If he lands it on you, back off immediately — he'll follow with Enrage-boosted autos that are trading his health for damage, so a long stunned trade is worse for you than for him.

yourWindow.when: his Q and W shield are both down
yourWindow.what: Walk E (Searing Charge) into terrain near him for the shockwave knockup, then land Q (Volcanic Rupture)'s fissure and follow-up magma pillar while he's slowed and Brittle. This is your highest-damage chain and he has nothing to stop it without Q up.

start.why: Best measured starting item here (57.8% over 64 games), and the passive sustain directly offsets Sion's early Enrage autos and poke.

boots.why: Highest win rate boots in this matchup (60.7% over 84 games) — Sion's damage is entirely physical, from his autos to his Enrage-boosted hits.

core.why: Core first item in both measured build paths; the burn punishes him for standing in melee range to use Enrage.
Part of the top-performing path (83.3% over 6 games); the damage reflect and Grievous Wounds specifically punish an AD-stacking auto-attacker like Enraged Sion.
Completes the highest-sampled core path and gives you the raw stats to win extended trades once he's out of Q.

you need a burst shield against magic damage instead of more physical tankiness
you're ahead and want scaling damage for teamfights

runes.keystoneWhy: The sustain from Grasp outlasts Sion's E (Enrage) trades, which are already draining his own health bar — you out-heal him in every poke exchange.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is run in 83.6% of games here at a 57% win rate — Teleport lets you reset after shoving with Sunfire Aegis stacks and still make it back for your jungler's dives.

playing.title: Track his Q cooldown, not his mana
playing.detail: Sion has no mana bar, so the only early tell for his all-in is Q (Cryptic Gaze) coming off its 12/11/10/9/8s cooldown. If you just watched it land or whiff on a minion, he has no stun for roughly 8-12 seconds.

playing.title: Let him spend HP on Enrage
playing.detail: E (Enrage) grants attack damage at the cost of his own health on every basic attack. Extended melee trades where he's actively using it are trades he's partly losing already — don't disengage early, match him.

playing.title: Don't stand near his shield when it's about to pop
playing.detail: W (Death's Caress) explodes in an area around him if it isn't destroyed, or he can detonate it early himself. Walk out during the last second of the shield rather than eating the burst for free.

playing.title: Chain E into Q off terrain
playing.detail: E (Searing Charge) only creates its shockwave knockup if you collide with terrain while charging. Use lane walls to land it, then immediately follow with Q (Volcanic Rupture)'s fissure and delayed pillar for the full damage and slow chain.

playing.title: Respect his ult only in extended fights
playing.detail: R (Cannibalism) is 90s cooldown and only matters while he's actively landing attacks at 100 range, healing himself and nearby allies and gaining attack speed. It does nothing on the first hit — disengage from long attrition fights once you see it pop.

playing.title: Hold your ult to punish his dive, not to start yours
playing.detail: R (Call of the Forge God) is 140s on first cast and travels toward you, so firing it blind wastes a massive cooldown. Save it to zone him off you or your jungler during his all-in rather than opening with it.

playing.title: Look for kills once Sunfire Aegis and Thornmail land
playing.detail: The measured data shows Ornn holds the solo-kill edge in this matchup — once your first two core items are up, start actively pressuring his wave and look for all-in windows instead of just farming.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, summoners, and all win rates/sample sizes above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning — why each trade pattern and timing works — is my own analysis built from the ability text, not OP.GG's.

stats.opponentTip: Ornn can kill pure tankers such as Sion easily. Ignore the airborne on his (Q) with either [W] or by moving away, while using [W] to avoid being stunned by his (R) before using your CC skills combo to deal damage.
